# Harbor Point Payroll Posting Verification — December 2025
Prepared by Lucas Thornton for Andre Okafor, Accounting Supervisor
## Source totals
Payroll register batch HP-1225-04, dated 12/31/2025, covers 12/01/2025–12/31/2025. The company uses the monthly IRS deposit schedule for federal employment taxes. Fatima Ellison matched the register to the approved time records and confirmed the amounts below.

| Payroll item | Amount |
| --- | ---: |
| Gross wages | $48,000.00 |
| Federal income tax withheld | $5,760.00 |
| Employee Social Security withheld | $2,976.00 |
| Employee Medicare withheld | $696.00 |
| Net pay | $38,568.00 |
| Employer Social Security expense | $2,976.00 |
| Employer Medicare expense | $696.00 |

Net pay agrees to gross wages less employee withholdings. Employer FICA expense is separate from employee deductions. No state income tax applies to this payroll batch.
## Proposed journal entry
- Debit Wages Expense, account 6100, $48,000.00.
- Debit Employer Payroll Tax Expense, account 6120, $3,762.00.
- Credit Federal Income Tax Payable, account 2210, $5,760.00.
- Credit Social Security Payable, account 2212, $5,952.00.
- Credit Medicare Payable, account 2214, $1,392.00.
- Credit Cash—Payroll, account 1015, $38,568.00.
- Total debits and credits are $51,672.00.

The Social Security and Medicare payable credits combine the employee withholdings and the matching employer amounts. Cash will be disbursed on 01/02/2026 through the company payroll account; the entry remains dated 12/31/2025 to recognize December wages.
## Tax deposit check
The federal tax liability for December includes income tax withheld plus both employee and employer FICA. The schedule notes that the December federal tax deposit was submitted on 01/20/2026. Retain the EFTPS confirmation with the payroll batch support and post the debit to the federal tax payable accounts when the bank debit clears.

errors.explanation: Employer payroll tax expense should equal employer Social Security of $2,976.00 plus employer Medicare of $696.00, totaling $3,672.00. The posted amount is $90.00 too high and makes the debit total inconsistent with the stated total.

errors.quote: December federal tax deposit was submitted on 01/20/2026
errors.explanation: For a monthly federal tax depositor, December employment taxes are due by 01/15/2026. The stated 01/20/2026 deposit date is late.
errors.fix: December federal tax deposit was submitted on 01/15/2026
